original_publication.title: Feeding friend and foe: ample pollen mitigates the effects of pollen theft for a gynodioecious plant, Polemonium foliosissimum (Polemoniaceae)
original_publication.authors: Alison K. Brody; P. Alexander Burnham; Brittany Smith

2015.manipulation_unit: pollen-source neighbourhood, not independently randomized single flowers
2015.source_removal: half of anthers removed from hermaphrodite neighbourhood plants on scheduled days

neighbourhood_pollen_receipt_effect.female: 32.2 percent lower pollen receipt in treatment neighbourhoods
neighbourhood_pollen_receipt_effect.hermaphrodite: 28.9 percent lower pollen receipt in treatment neighbourhoods

2016.manipulation_unit: neighbourhood-week, with repeated focal plants, not individual flowers
2016.source_removal: half of anthers experimentally removed in neighbourhoods; odd/even neighbourhood treatment rotated
2016.exposure: once every 5 to 6 days; first five weeks used for analysis
2016.hand_supplementation: three inflorescences of six per focal plant assigned to supplemental hand pollen; other three sham

pollen_receipt.females: no measured reduction in mean pollen receipt
pollen_receipt.hermaphrodites: 20.0 percent numeric reduction, group/main test non-significant

visitor_single_visit.note: different remaining grains are not equal to experimentally measured donor depletion from equal initial supplies

data_recovery.public_archive_status: Raw individual/neighbourhood tables were not located in the publisher supplementary list or targeted Dryad/Zenodo searches; this does not establish that no data exist elsewhere.

interpretation_constraints: 2015 pollen-receipt response and 2016 supplementation interaction are different year/design endpoints; do not treat as a matched replicated within-year factor interaction
No study intervention independently randomized the number or quality of effective pollinator visits
2016 non-significant interaction is not proof of equivalent treatment effects or absence of pollen-source limitation
Seed output is female reproduction; no donor genetic paternity or male fitness was observed
Repeated flowers/stalks within neighbourhoods do not supply independent neighbourhood treatment replication
No measured late pollen quality or controlled visitor sequence in this study
No U6 V4 architecture admission or direct BALANCE L,K,Phi was measured
source_text_access: Publisher HTML read, doi resolved and article Results and Methods manually crosschecked; raw source bytes not locally archived.
